description: This Dart source file defines a class SavedNewsDb responsible for managing CRUD operations on saved news articles within a local SQLite database for a Flutter application. It includes database initialization, insertion (upsert), deletion, and retrieval functionalities, interfacing with the NewsArticle model.

classes.name: SavedNewsDb
classes.description: A data access class for handling the persistence of news articles in a SQLite database within a Flutter application.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Initializes the database if not already initialized, creating the required table if needed.

methods.name: _database
methods.description: Getter that returns the active database instance or throws an error if not initialized.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a NewsArticle in the database.

methods.name: deleteByHeadline
methods.description: Deletes a news article from the database based on its headline.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all saved news articles from the database, ordered by time descending.
